You can just click on the boss and you’ll be able to see what they’re about to do. Plus as long as you borrow a level 90 carry of any type and run 3 fitting supports, they shouldn’t get to trigger your DR enough to the point where you die.

You should aim to trigger the boss’s second phase with your first turn so they don’t attack you.
